ValidationRule.description: INC0140238 -[ Deactivated this rule and replaced.] When the "Infrastructure-License Key Purpose" is set to Tanium as a Service, make the "Server Hostnames" not required. It's redundant since they will be completing the Vanity field.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: IF(AND(NOT( ISPICKVAL(Server_Device_Type__c , "Tanium as a Service")),OR(ISBLANK( Server_Hostnames__c ), ISBLANK( Country__c )) ), TRUE, FALSE)
ValidationRule.errorMessage: please enter values for Server Hostnames and Country fields.
